scripts.build: node scripts/with-env.mjs build pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=3
scripts.lint: node scripts/with-env.mjs build pnpm exec turbo run lint --concurrency=3 && node scripts/with-env.mjs build pnpm exec eslint scripts e2e playwright.config.ts
scripts.test: node scripts/with-env.mjs test pnpm exec turbo run test --concurrency=3 && pnpm test:env
scripts.test:env: node scripts/with-env.mjs test node --test scripts/env.test.mjs scripts/routerai-route-check.test.mjs scripts/housing-unicode-preflight.test.mjs scripts/routerai-native-cost-observation.test.mjs
scripts.ai:policy:preview: node scripts/with-env.mjs api pnpm exec tsx apps/api/src/preview-policy.ts
scripts.test:containers: node scripts/with-env.mjs test node --test scripts/container-runtime.test.mjs scripts/gigachat-ca.test.mjs scripts/container-stop-check.test.mjs scripts/ingress-maintenance.test.mjs
scripts.test:release: node scripts/with-env.mjs test node --test scripts/release-candidate.test.mjs scripts/deploy-main.test.mjs scripts/operator-release.test.mjs scripts/image-content.test.mjs scripts/release-upgrade-12-smoke.test.mjs scripts/release-upgrade-18-smoke.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/with-env.mjs build pnpm exec turbo run typecheck --concurrency=3
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:containers && pnpm test:release && pnpm build && pnpm test:startup
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/with-env.mjs test pnpm exec playwright test
